# Project Context Note

## Organization

Willow Brook Services coordinates internal support activities for several
teams. Requests currently arrive through a shared mailbox, direct messages,
and a spreadsheet maintained by service coordinators.

## Initial Intent

The organization is considering a Service Request Workspace. Staff should be
able to submit a request and see its progress. Service coordinators should be
able to review incoming requests, assign work, and close completed requests.

The stated objective is to reduce lost requests and make workload easier to
understand.

## Timing

The service manager would like something available before the next seasonal
peak. The date of that peak and the meaning of "available" have not been
recorded.

## Available Participants

The service manager and two coordinators attended the initial discussion. No
representative of requesters, security, support, legal, or data governance was
identified.
